items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: Red Norvelle and Jimmy Dorsey and all these different bands, and I was making myself about $300.00 a week.

ctx.x: So he bought me a record of Frankie Trumbauer Trombaer singing the Blues." And I fell in love with that style so I started buying all the things that Frankie Trumbauer made, that he made
with Bix and Ed Lang and Miff Mole and Jimmy Dorsey, different ones. But I bought everything because of Frankie Trumbauer. And I learned his style on alto.

Then I bought me a banjo book, A McNeills (PHONETIC) Banjo book, and learned the cycle of the 5th, and chords, and I practiced all these on my saxophone. So now this improved my playing very much. Then I got interested in writing and I started to write a little bit, you know.
